name: Post-Code Change Validation
description: Validate code changes after they're made to catch runtime issues

then.prompt:
POST-WRITE VALIDATION - A file was just modified. Perform these checks:

1. RUNTIME ERROR CHECK:
   - If admin_portal/views.py or member_portal/views.py was modified:
   - Scan for json.dumps() with Decimal fields (from Sum/Avg/aggregate)
   - Scan for undefined variable references
   - Scan for missing imports
   - Report any potential runtime errors

2. TEMPLATE SYNC CHECK:
   - If a view file was modified and context variables changed:
   - List all templates that use this view
   - Check if templates need updates to match new context structure
   - Report any mismatches

3. JAVASCRIPT SYNC CHECK:
   - If templates/admin/home.html was modified:
   - Verify JavaScript data.field references match Python context keys
   - Check that formatAmount() is used for currency display
   - Report any undefined property access

4. MIGRATION CHECK:
   - If accounts/models.py was modified:
   - Run: docker-compose exec -T web python manage.py makemigrations --dry-run
   - Report if migrations are needed

5. QUICK SMOKE TEST:
   - Predict if the modified code would crash on first execution
   - Check for common errors: missing imports, undefined variables, type mismatches
   - Report confidence level: SAFE / RISKY / WILL CRASH

Provide a summary with any issues found and suggested fixes.
